External loading requires it to load every time, which can cause extra communication charges for some people. Also, Google Drive is unstable and YouTube does not load with Quest.
https://docs.vrchat.com/docs/www-whitelist
​
# Related
- [Add github​.com into Video Player Whitelist](https://vrchat.canny.io/open-beta/p/add-githubcom-into-video-player-whitelist)
It is surprising to see this canny is still open and not yet implemented.
I'd really like this to be implemented. I often like to use videos within my worlds for textures, looping signs, etc. Not being able to do this with Udon means I am stuck on SDK2 still.

The above post was somehow closed without being moved, so I posted a new one with the same content in a category that is appropriate at this time.
https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/add-githubcom-into-video-player-whitelist

Well?  This seems like very basic functionality to me. What's the deal? If it's related to "white listing" I don't get the connection.  Nothing stops people from using offensive still textures, why would video textures be any different? I just want to put a little video loop on a TV screen.

details: It will be nice to be able to use embedded video clips with the new video player system for things like video textures. Currently (on the open beta build 986) we can only load videos from external servers.
title: Video Clip support in Udon Video Players
